title: Declarative connector (registry/connectors/<source>.yaml)
description: Configures a generic driver for one source (docs/architecture-v2/03-ingestion.md §2.2). The envelope is common; each driver defines its own sections.

expect.description: Declarative expectations checked on every staging (03 §5.2).

kind.description: Features only: count the features of this kind.

src_fields.description: Where a text comes from and how it is transformed (engine/crates/lanka-ingest/src/drivers/table.rs).

since.description: Observations whose period starts on or after the period this source evaluates to (output frequency) take codes[code], e.g. projections from the edition year read per series from a metadata table.

feature.description: One feature per row: a point (lon + lat) or, with `line`, a LineString through points of another table.

distinct.description: Rows repeating an earlier row's key fold into it (the output table is the vertex table of `line.through`).

line.description: Line through ordered points: the rows of `through` whose `by` column equals this row's feature key, in table order (or sorted by numeric `order`), each naming a point (column `point`) of `points.table` by its `points.key`.

lon.description: Vertices with their own coordinates: lon and lat columns of `through` (instead of point + points).

count.description: Declared integer field that receives the number of vertices.

section.description: Section rows (a block label printed alone, such as a year above a block of districts) are removed; their label fills a new column `into` for the rows below.

zip_member.description: Regex of the zip member this file reads, when it differs from extract.zip_member.

explode.description: One record per element of the array at `path` (relative to the record): `fields` are read from the parent record, `field` receives the element's text and `index` its 1-based position.
